signals.ref: <component ref + part, exactly as C03 names it, e.g. U_AP (STM32N657L0)>
signals.pin: <physical ball/pin from a C03 pinmap row, e.g. PA2>
signals.firmware_signal: <signal name FW will use; default to the net name>

note: Bridges the C03 pin map to firmware signal responsibilities. Driver/ISR/init code is FW-team owned. Every signal MUST trace to a C03 pinmap row — no invented pins. If C03 delivered only an interface subset, bridge that subset and record the missing-connectivity boundary here rather than back-filling.
